name: fast-router
description: Fast-Router CLI - Start and manage Fast-Router server

scripts.dev: nodemon -I --watch cli.js --watch src --watch hooks --ext js,json cli.js

comment_sqlite: sql.js + better-sqlite3 are NOT bundled here. They are installed into ~/.fast-router/runtime/node_modules by hooks/postinstall.js (and re-checked at runtime by cli.js). This avoids Windows EBUSY errors when updating the global CLI, since native .node files no longer live under the locked install dir.
comment_systray: systray2 is NOT bundled here. It is lazy-installed into ~/.fast-router/runtime/node_modules by hooks/postinstall.js on macOS/Linux only. Windows uses PowerShell NotifyIcon (zero binary). This avoids shipping unsigned Go binaries that trigger antivirus false positives.
